Problem Statement:
Write a program to replace by "*" in the middle of a string. 
Input Description:
Enter the string 
Output Description:
Replace by " * " in the middle of the string 
Explanation:
If it is odd replace by "*" in the middle of the string.If it is even replace "**" in the middle of the string 
Sample Input:
dharma 
Sample Output:
dh**ma
